notes: Partition verified: 25 source / 31 target, each used once.
The interrogative הַ is unrepresented because the ASV marks the question by inversion alone, and the fronted *Were* joins the predicate מְעַט as a discontinuous unit (rules 20, 25).
The object suffix on וַתִּזְבָּחִים is realized by the demonstrative *these*, which is the pronoun the ASV actually writes for it (rule 18).
